audit.why: Zac 1-3, Skill at 4-5 and 6, Yi at first item and 2+. phases[].side and win[] agree row for row with the packet chart (the full layer marks Level 3 as Zac and content agrees).
His levels 2-5 and level 6 R against your Highlander and first on-hit item — that matches the chart flipping to you at first item and never back.
audit.corrected: Let's Bounce!'s 120s rank-1 cooldown and Unstable Matter's 5s added so the windows are concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields call his Q 'point-and-click' (enemyWin, tradeBad, phases[1].why, breakdown.trading), and content spikes[1] says Let's Bounce 'interrupts your Highlander charge'.
audit.why: Stretching Strikes is an 800-range arm grab flagged as a projectile — it is aimed, so it can be sidestepped, and its knock only happens when he attacks a SECOND enemy and throws both together. Calling it point-and-click tells a player not to bother dodging the ability that starts every trade. And Highlander has no charge or channel: it is an instant self-buff. The thing his knockup actually cancels is Meditate.
audit.corrected: Q described as an 800-range grab; the Highlander interrupt claim replaced with the Meditate cancel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that Cell Division REVIVES him, and Unstable Matter's percent-max-health damage is barely present.
audit.why: On fatal damage Zac splits into 4 bloblets and revives off whatever survives — so a Yi who kills him and walks away has not killed him, and Grievous Wounds plus killing the blobs is the actual finish. Unstable Matter deals a percentage of max health as MAGIC damage every 5s, which is why armour stacking is the wrong answer against him.
audit.corrected: Revive and the blob finish written into report[5]; the percent-max-health W into tradeBad, enemyWin and spikes[0].

edits.before: Zac wins by abusing levels 1-5: he slings in with E, lands his Q knock and W, and chunks me with point-and-click CC before I can scale, then walks away on his passive blob heals. If he gets help from his jungler while my Q is on cooldown, his lockdown catches me with no escape and snowballs the lane.
edits.after: Zac wins by abusing levels 1-5: he slings in with E, grabs me with Stretching Strikes from 800 units and burns percent max health with Unstable Matter every 5s, then walks away on his passive blob heals. If his jungler arrives while my Q is down, his lockdown catches me with no escape and snowballs the lane.

edits.before: A level-2 brawl where he point-and-click Q knocks me up and W's me before Wuju Style or Q is available to answer.
edits.after: A level-2 brawl where Stretching Strikes grabs me from 800 units and Unstable Matter shreds percent max HP before Wuju is up.

edits.before: His point-and-click Q knock-up at level 2 chunks me before Wuju Style true damage is online, so I just farm and concede the trade.
edits.after: His 800-range Stretching Strikes grab at level 2 chunks me before Wuju Style true damage is online, so I just farm and concede the trade.

edits.before: Early: he initiates with E or point-and-click Q and wins; I refuse and farm. Mid: I trade only with Wuju Style active and Q held to disengage. Late: I bait or dodge his E with Q, then sit on him with on-hit autos while Meditate negates his returning blob heal.
edits.after: Early: he initiates with E or an 800-range Stretching Strikes grab and wins; I refuse and farm. Mid: I trade only with Wuju Style active and Q held to disengage. Late: I bait or dodge his E with Q, then sit on him with on-hit autos while Meditate negates his returning blob heal.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his E sling damage, Q knock-up, and R airborne; Wuju Style's true damage ignores his armor stacking; Meditate out-channels the heal his passive blobs return; Highlander's slow immunity beats his slows and resets off kills.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges his E sling, the Stretching Strikes grab and R airborne; Wuju Style's true damage ignores his armour; and his passive revives him into four bloblets — bring Grievous Wounds and kill the blobs, or the kill does not count.

edits.before: Zac pokes with Stretching Strike (Q) blob-lashes and his passive blob-pickup sustain out-lasts your early Alpha Strike trades. Levels 1-2 are his; from 3 on it's skill-and-wave dependent as your resets come online.
edits.after: Zac pokes with Stretching Strikes (Q) from 800 units while Unstable Matter (W) burns percent max health every 5s, and blob pickups out-last your Alpha Strike trades. Levels 1-2 are his; from 3 it turns skill-and-wave dependent.

edits.before: Let's Bounce (R) is a multi-knockup ult that interrupts your Highlander charge and peels for his team. Around 6 it stays even — bait his Elastic Slingshot (E) engage and Q before you commit.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! (R) bounces four times, knocking up and slowing — Highlander is instant so there is nothing to interrupt, but it does cancel Meditate. It is 120s at rank 1: bait his Elastic Slingshot (E), then commit.

edits.after: Zac wins levels 1-2: Stretching Strikes (Q) grabs you from 800 units and his passive blobs heal him through your Alpha Strike, so farm and avoid feeding that sustain with bad trades.

notes: IMPORTANT FLAG CONFLICT: Elastic Slingshot (E) carries a derived 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' flag, and _missing lists 'Zac can deny your mobility (Alpha Strike) with Elastic Slingshot (E)'. Riot's own description is only 'Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward' — no grounding effect at all, and the flag looks like a tooltip parse of the word 'ground'. Per the trust-the-description rule I did NOT write any grounding claim, and I left the page's existing advice (hold Alpha Strike to dodge his E) untouched. If that flag is real, roughly eight fields telling the player to save Q for his engage are wrong — worth a decision. suspectNames flagged 'Stretching Strike' and 'Let's Bounce'; both were genuinely off (plural, and the exclamation mark) and are corrected.
